instruction: Create one Part Design body. First create an additive box blank sized 45 mm along global X, 28 mm along global Y, and 20 mm along global Z, with its lower-back-left corner at the origin so the box spans X = 0 to 45, Y = 0 to 28, and Z = 0 to 20. Then create a subtractive ellipsoid with its principal axes aligned to the global axes, radii 14 mm along X, 8 mm along Y, and 6 mm along Z, centered at (22.5, 14, 20). This should cut a centered ellipsoidal recess into the top face, with the deepest point at Z = 14 and the ellipsoid center on the top face. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
